paper_metadata.title: Ultra-low temperature mechanical response of VCoNi medium-entropy alloy with unprecedented high strength and ductility

evidence.quote: This work reports on the unprecedented high tensile strength and ductility of single-phase VCoNi medium-entropy alloys (MEAs) at liquid helium temperature (4.2 K)
